# NetSuite for Mobile Glossary

NetSuite for Mobile Glossary (3 pages): NetSuite for Mobile Glossary

## Chapters
- [NetSuite for Mobile Glossary](chapter_1556006042.md): The next two sections cover mobile icons and supported record types.
  - [Mobile Icons Glossary](section_158581482645.md): This glossary contains a list of icons used in NetSuite for Mobile help documentation.
  - [Mobile Supported Record Types](section_1553696109.md): The app supports the following record types: | Record Type | Supported Actions (Basic Actions = Create, Delete, Edit, Reset, Save) | | --- | --- | | Bills | Basic Actions, Autofill, Cancel Bill, Recalculate | | Cases | Basic Actions, Grab | | Contacts | Basic Actions | | Customers | Basic Actions, Accept Payment | | Custom Records | Basic Actions | | Employees | Basic Actions | | Estimates | Basic Actions, Autofill, Cash Sale, Invoice, Sales Order | | Events | Basic Actions, Accept, Decline, Decline this Date, Quick Accept, Tentative | | Expense Reports | Basic Actions, Approve, Complete Later, Reject, Submit.
